proposed_statement_changes.proposed:
If \(X\) has fixed finite support with every support mass bounded below, and if the fixed-\(L\) folds satisfy \(\min_{1\le\ell\le L}|I_\ell^c|\ge c_Fn\) for some fixed \(c_F>0\), the foldwise cell-frequency estimator of the corrected shared-cell covariance \(\Gamma_P(X)=\operatorname{Cov}_P\{\Psi_P(O)\mid X\}\) satisfies
\[
\max_\ell\|\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}-\Gamma\|_{P_X,4,\mathrm{op}}
=O_P(n^{-1/2}+r_{p,n}+r_{m,n}).
\]
All conditional expectations used in a correctly specified one-step construction are estimated by the corresponding cell averages. If, in addition, contrast rank is fixed and its positive spectrum is separated, parametric first stages and \(\tau_n=n^{-a}\) with \(0<a<1/4\) give consistent rank recovery, \(r_{\Gamma,n}=O(n^{-1/2})\), and \(r_{b,n}=O(n^{-1/2+a})\), with \(r_{b,n}^2+r_{\Gamma,n}^2=o(n^{-1/2})\). The continuous-covariate \(L_4(P_X)\) rate in the original statement does not follow from only a conditional fourth moment for outcomes.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The displayed root-\(n\) rate requires every training complement to contain order \(n\) observations. Fixed \(L\) by itself does not imply this: for example, a two-fold partition may have one training complement of size one. The added fold-balance condition is an estimator-side sampling condition, not a restriction on the observed-law model, and the rest of the claim is unchanged.

proposed.statement: Let \(\widehat r^{-\ell}(x)=\#\{j:\lambda_j(N^{\prime}\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}(x)N)>\tau_n\}\), and form \(\widehat H^{-\ell}\) and \(\widehat b^{-\ell}\) from the retained eigencomponents. Under fixed rank, separated positive spectrum, \(L_4(P_X)\) covariance error, and \(r_{\Gamma,n}=o(\tau_n)\), \(P_X\{\widehat r^{-\ell}(X)\ne r_0\}=O_P\{(r_{\Gamma,n}/\tau_n)^4\}\) uniformly over folds. The thresholded Moore--Penrose perturbation and its projector obey \[\max_{\ell}\|\widehat b^{-\ell}-b^{\star}\|_{P_X,2}+\max_{\ell}\|\widehat b^{-\ell}-b^{\star}\|_{P_X,4}=O_P(r_{b,n})=o_P(1),\qquad r_{b,n}=r_{\Gamma,n}/\tau_n.\] On the consistently selected spectral range the sharper local bound is \(O_P(r_{\Gamma,n})\). Thus both rank recovery and the loading rate are derived from covariance learning and threshold separation rather than supplied by an oracle rank or a standalone loading assumption.
proposed.justification: The learned loading rate must follow from covariance estimation and stable quotient geometry rather than being assumed as an independent first-stage property.
proposed.gap: Standard Moore--Penrose perturbation bounds do not by themselves control the DDD loading in \(L_4(P_X)\); the conditional moment envelope and the affine fixed-rank construction close that step.
proposed.consumer: The result supplies the loading remainder bound used by both the efficient estimator and the efficiency-gap estimator.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The proof uses the displayed joint-score formula to derive the uniform conditional fourth-moment and covariance bounds needed for the pseudoinverse perturbation. Adding Definition \(\ref{def:pairwise-score}\) makes that load-bearing dependency explicit; the claim and all other metadata are unchanged.
